description.value:
You dispense a dose of kolto to one creature you can see within range, restoring 1d4 plus your techcasting ability modifier hit points. This power has no effect on droids or constructs.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d4 per slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
